capabilities.description: Supervisor capabilities pushed by the Service installer (e.g. supports_granular_rbac).

statefulSet.description: Configuration settings specific to the Kubernetes StatefulSet deployment of the secret store.

storageClassName.description: Name of the storage class to be used for persistent volumes required by the StatefulSet.

virtualIP.description: Autowired property, do not enter value - Control plane address. This is the IP or hostname that external components will use to communicate with the secret store's control plane.
